description: Closed catalog of explicit, change-scoped hosted CI packs. Candidate identity is bound at dispatch time.

admission_checks: DCO check on the exact pull request head
negative_controls: reject malformed or mismatched candidate SHA
reject a candidate surface with no named focused job

exact_sha.binding: must equal github.sha for the checked-out dispatch ref
exact_sha.target_base_sha: required workflow_dispatch input target_base_sha; must be an ancestor of expected_sha

global_suite_escalation_triggers: shared dependency manifests, workspace configuration, or central test infrastructure changes
authentication, authorization, cryptographic, or protocol boundary changes
cross-service migrations or shared data contracts
release, signing, deployment, secrets, or provider mutation controls change
the pack cannot bound affected consumers
merge_evidence: exact pack run URL, run ID, candidate SHA, target base SHA, and conclusion
actionlint and adversarial verifier job receipts
DCO check on the exact pull request head
one independent cold review verdict and disposition of each finding
documented escalation decision for every critical surface touched
